title: Brainwashed Bliss
description:
You already know what my voice does to you, and you came back anyway. Good.

Brainwashed Bliss is the session where your love of hypnosis stops being a secret and becomes a certainty. I take you down slowly, then deeper, then deeper than that, until the drop itself is the thing you crave and my voice is the only place you want to fall. By the end, one little word will pull you straight back into that quiet room with me… anywhere, anytime… and you’ll love that I have that kind of access.

You love being hypnotized, don’t you? Yesss… of course you do. And the more you listen, the more you’ll love it, and the more you’ll come back to me. That’s exactly how this works.

So press play, pet. Hand your mind over one more time… and let me show you what bliss really sounds like.

Buy it now. I’ll be waiting.
author: Mistress Amethyst
